CheckTitle: ELB ALB with mitigation mode defensive and not dropping invalid header fields
Description: ELB ALBs found without mitigation mode set to strictest level and dropping invalid header fields.
Risk: Not enabling these exposes the load balancer to HTTP request smuggling attacks and other desynchronization associated risks.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure desync mitigation mode is configured for ALBs to the strictest setting, and enable the feature to drop invalid header fields.
